title: Lutke Watan se Aai Hu Amma
body:
Kaise kahu kya layi hu amma
lutke watan me aai hu amma
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Khushk gale par chalta tha khanjar
dekha hai maine wo ghum ka manzar
bhai ko khokar aai hu amma
lutke watan me aai hu amma
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Shaah ghamo ki bazm the amma
zakhm ke andar zakhm the amma
dekh ke wo bhi aai hu amma
lutke watan me aai hu amma
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Sar khule mai bazar e sitam tak
kaise gai darbaar e sitam tak
haa ye batane aai hu amma
lutke watan me aai hu amma
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Bete kaha hai bhai kaha hai
rassi ke baazu par ab nisha hai
haaye bohot dukh paayi hu amma
lutke watan me aai hu amma
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Jisne tamache khaaye the mu par
jiske chine the nanhe se gauhar
uski bhi chadar laai hu amma
lutke watan me aai hu amma
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Hilti thi qabr e fatema zehra
ro ro ke jab ye kehti thi dukhiya
gham ki sunani laai hu amma
lutke watan me aai hu amma
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Bus ae sharar naqvi aur ehsan
kehti thi zainab nana ka gulshan
ban me lutake aai hu amma
lutke watan me aai hu amma
kaise kahu kya layi hu amma
lutke watan me aai hu amma
